nodes.label: Module: Sketch Effects (overlay / threshold / progressive)
nodes.author: Jean Moreno
nodes.rationale: Sketch texture overlay on shadowed areas; Threshold variant used for halftone-like effects; Progressive uses special textures simulating added strokes with less light

nodes.label: Module: Terrain Shader (Unity terrain integration)
nodes.author: Jean Moreno
nodes.rationale: Base Maps are baked textures used instead of regular layer blending when terrain is viewed from a long distance to save performances; per-layer terrain variables are reused for custom purposes (e.g. layer specular color as shadow color)

nodes.label: Module: Texture Blending (splatting)
nodes.author: Jean Moreno
nodes.rationale: The order in which textures are sampled matters when using height blending, because the alpha from the textures is cumulative

nodes.label: TCP2 'Make Optional' shader-feature toggle pattern
nodes.author: Jean Moreno
nodes.rationale: Repeated module pattern: a XXX_SHADER_FEATURE option emits '#pragma shader_feature_local TCP2_XXX' plus a [Toggle] material property to make an effect optional in the material inspector (used by Dissolve, MatCap, Normal Map, Rim, Sketch, Specular, Subsurface).

nodes.label: VertExmotion Vertex Animation Library
nodes.rationale: External package (VertExmotion.cginc) providing baked vertex animation (position / position+normal) driven by vertex-color data; sampled in the TCP2 vertex shader, with URP-specific VertExmotionURP entry.

nodes.label: Vertex Displacement effect
nodes.rationale: Texture-based vertex displacement in Object or World space; can be made optional via shader keyword TCP2_VERTEX_DISPLACEMENT so it can be toggled in the material inspector instead of always active.

nodes.label: Vertical Fog effect
nodes.rationale: Fog blended by Y threshold; can use global lighting-settings fog color (unity_FogColor), smoothstep interpolation, local/camera space, world-position offset, or alpha-weighted fog.

nodes.label: Vertex sine waves (water vertex animation)
nodes.rationale: Layered sum of 1/2/4/8 sine functions animating vertices; world-vertex mode keeps tiled meshes seamless, world-object mode moves the whole object (floating objects); can recalc normals assuming a planar mesh or rotate along the wave normal.

nodes.label: Depth-based water effects
nodes.rationale: Colors the water by depth buffer so immersed objects alter water color; depth-based foam at intersections with other objects (optionally animated foam texture, smooth foam, hide on backfaces); depth-based transparency (requires alpha transparency); optional depth view correction.

nodes.label: Wind Animation effect
nodes.rationale: Simulates wind via layered sine waves or a scrolling noise texture; wind mask and time offset come from vertex colors (mask RGB, phase from G); optional object rotation along the wind; TODO notes a pivot-based wind option as in Book of the Dead.

nodes.label: Low Poly Sci-Fi Turrets Demo Readme
Sci-Fi Turret Models (2 models, 4 prefabs)
nodes.rationale: 2 turret models (344-462 tris, 25-30 KB, 2x256x256 textures) with 4 prefabs, compatible with URP and HDRP.

nodes.label: Cartoon Shader (URP, Unity 6000.0.33f1)
nodes.rationale: Toon/cel shader for URP: uses the scene main light for shadows/highlights; params for base color, shadows, outline, highlight, glow; gradients are stored as images (Photoshop) in the Shader Graph and cannot be edited in the material editor - edit the Photoshop file and re-import.

nodes.label: DOTween Tweening Library (DG.Tweening)
nodes.author: Daniele Giardini (Demigiant)
nodes.rationale: Tweening engine for Unity (copyright 2014-2026 Demigiant); modules activated/deactivated via DOTween Utility Panel (Tools > Demigiant > DOTween Utility Panel, Setup DOTween... button); upgrading from <1.2.815 requires overwriting files in Plugins/Demigiant and reopening Unity without safe mode.

nodes.label: Liberation Sans / Arimo / Tinos / Cousine Font
nodes.rationale: Font derived from Google's Arimo/Tinos/Cousine data (2010) with Red Hat's Liberation reserved name; distributed under SIL Open Font License 1.1, which allows free use/modification/redistribution provided fonts aren't sold standalone and derivatives stay under OFL.
